    📓 Building a world? The campaign notebook keeps the NPCs you save there next to your towns, gods, and factions, with notes.

    💡 DM Tip: Save your favorite NPCs to the grimoire! They'll persist between sessions, but only in this browser: clearing site data or switching devices empties the grimoire, so 💾 back up everything now and then. To share one, use 🔗 Copy Link: the link rolls the same NPC on any device, and Back steps to the previous roll. Tick saved NPCs and use 🖨️ Print Selected to print your whole cast on one sheet. Need only a name for a passer-by? Roll ten with 📜 Just a Name. Click any spell in a stat block to read it, or open the whole list in the Spellbook.
